title: Sekiz Yapraklı Çiçek

# Sekiz Yapraklı Çiçek
import turtle as t
import math as m

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#05030a")
s.colormode(255)
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()
p.width(1.3)


def layer(size, turn, rings, rgb):
    for i in range(rings, 0, -1):
        f = i / rings
        p.pencolor(int(rgb[0] * f), int(rgb[1] * f), int(rgb[2] * f))
        for k in range(8):
            base = m.radians(turn + k * 45)
            p.penup()
            for j in range(-15, 16):
                phi = j / 15 * m.pi / 8
                d = size * f * max(0, m.cos(4 * phi)) ** 0.5
                p.goto(d * m.cos(base + phi), d * m.sin(base + phi))
                p.pendown()
        s.update()


layer(280, 0, 22, (235, 240, 255))
layer(200, 22.5, 18, (120, 170, 255))
layer(135, 0, 14, (255, 120, 210))
layer(75, 22.5, 10, (255, 60, 90))

p.penup()
p.goto(0, 0)
p.dot(26, "#ff0033")
p.dot(8, "white")
s.update()
t.done()

code:
# Altıgen Yıldız İpliği
import turtle as t
import math as m

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("black")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()
p.width(1)

R = 300
r = R / m.sqrt(3)
n = 24
colors = ["#ff4d6d", "#ffb347", "#fff275", "#7cff9e", "#62d2ff", "#c792ff"]


def lerp(a, b, f):
    return (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f)


def line(a, b):
    p.penup()
    p.goto(a)
    p.pendown()
    p.goto(b)


for k in range(6):
    tip = (R * m.cos(m.radians(k * 60)), R * m.sin(m.radians(k * 60)))
    left = (r * m.cos(m.radians(k * 60 - 30)), r * m.sin(m.radians(k * 60 - 30)))
    right = (r * m.cos(m.radians(k * 60 + 30)), r * m.sin(m.radians(k * 60 + 30)))
    p.pencolor(colors[k])
    for i in range(n + 1):
        f = i / n
        line(lerp((0, 0), left, f), lerp(left, tip, f))
        line(lerp((0, 0), right, f), lerp(right, tip, f))
        line(lerp(left, tip, f), lerp(tip, right, f))
        s.update()

t.done()

# Sonbahar Ağacı
import turtle as t
import random

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#0b0603")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()

leaves = ["#ff7b00", "#ffb700", "#e63946", "#f4a261", "#ffd60a"]


def branch(length, depth):
    if depth == 0:
        p.dot(random.randint(5, 9), random.choice(leaves))
        return
    p.width(depth * 1.1)
    p.pencolor("#8a5a3c" if depth > 4 else "#c98b6b")
    p.pendown()
    p.forward(length)
    a = random.uniform(18, 30)
    p.left(a)
    branch(length * random.uniform(0.68, 0.76), depth - 1)
    p.right(2 * a)
    branch(length * random.uniform(0.68, 0.76), depth - 1)
    p.left(a)
    p.penup()
    p.backward(length)
    s.update()


p.penup()
p.goto(0, -320)
p.setheading(90)
branch(125, 10)
s.update()
t.done()

# Kardiyoid (Çarpım Tablosu ×2)
import turtle as t
import math as m
import colorsys

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("black")
s.tracer(0)

p.hideturtle()

def point(i):
    a = 2 * m.pi * i / N + m.pi
    return R * m.cos(a), R * m.sin(a)

    p.pendown()
    p.goto(point(i * 2 % N))
    s.update()

t.done()

# Koch Kar Tanesi
import turtle as t

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#020814")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()


def koch(length, depth):
    if depth == 0:
        p.forward(length)
        return
    length /= 3
    koch(length, depth - 1)
    p.left(60)
    koch(length, depth - 1)
    p.right(120)
    koch(length, depth - 1)
    p.left(60)
    koch(length, depth - 1)


def snowflake(size, depth, color, x, y):
    p.penup()
    p.goto(x, y)
    p.setheading(0)
    p.pendown()
    p.pencolor(color)
    p.width(2)
    for _ in range(3):
        koch(size, depth)
        p.right(120)
        s.update()

snowflake(300, 3, "#b48cff", -150, 87)
snowflake(150, 2, "white", -75, 43)

# Parabolik Köşeler
import turtle as t

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#050505")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()

L = 300
n = 30
corners = [((-L, -L), (1, 0), (0, 1), "#ff5c8a"),
           ((L, -L), (0, 1), (-1, 0), "#ffc857"),
           ((L, L), (-1, 0), (0, -1), "#4cd4ff"),
           ((-L, L), (0, -1), (1, 0), "#9b7bff")]


def line(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    p.penup()
    p.goto(x1, y1)
    p.pendown()
    p.goto(x2, y2)


for (cx, cy), (ax, ay), (bx, by), col in corners:
    p.pencolor(col)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        d1 = 2 * L * i / n
        d2 = 2 * L * (n - i) / n
        line(cx + ax * d1, cy + ay * d1, cx + bx * d2, cy + by * d2)
        s.update()

p.pencolor("white")
for qx, qy in [(1, 1), (-1, 1), (-1, -1), (1, -1)]:
    for i in range(n + 1):
        a = L * 0.6 * i / n
        line(qx * a, 0, 0, qy * (L * 0.6 - a))
    s.update()

t.done()

title: Torus (Simit)
code:
# Torus (Simit)
import turtle as t
import math as m

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("black")
s.colormode(255)
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()
p.width(1)

R, r = 190, 85
tilt = m.radians(62)


def project(u, v):
    x = (R + r * m.cos(v)) * m.cos(u)
    y = (R + r * m.cos(v)) * m.sin(u)
    z = r * m.sin(v)
    y2 = y * m.cos(tilt) - z * m.sin(tilt)
    z2 = y * m.sin(tilt) + z * m.cos(tilt)
    return x * 1.15, y2 * 1.15, z2


def shade(z):
    f = (z + R + r) / (2 * (R + r))
    return int(40 + 60 * f), int(80 + 175 * f), int(120 + 135 * f)


def ring(fixed, along_u):
    p.penup()
    for j in range(81):
        a = 2 * m.pi * j / 80
        x, y, z = project(a, fixed) if along_u else project(fixed, a)
        p.pencolor(shade(z))
        p.goto(x, y)
        p.pendown()
    s.update()


for i in range(36):
    ring(2 * m.pi * i / 36, False)
for i in range(16):
    ring(2 * m.pi * i / 16, True)

t.done()

    sierpinski(a, mid(a, b), mid(a, c), depth - 1)
    sierpinski(mid(a, b), b, mid(b, c), depth - 1)
    sierpinski(mid(a, c), mid(b, c), c, depth - 1)

p.hideturtle()

def go():
    p.pencolor(colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(count[0] / total, 0.8, 1))

    p.right(angle)

    go()
    p.left(angle)
    hilbert(level - 1, angle)
    go()
    hilbert(level - 1, angle)
    p.left(angle)
    go()
    hilbert(level - 1, -angle)
    p.right(angle)

import turtle as t

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#000208")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()

R = 280
ax = m.radians(25)
ay = m.radians(20)


def project(lat, lon):
    x = m.cos(lat) * m.cos(lon)
    y = m.sin(lat)
    z = m.cos(lat) * m.sin(lon)
    x, z = x * m.cos(ay) + z * m.sin(ay), -x * m.sin(ay) + z * m.cos(ay)
    y, z = y * m.cos(ax) - z * m.sin(ax), y * m.sin(ax) + z * m.cos(ax)
    return x * R, y * R, z


def path(points):
    p.penup()
    for x, y, z in points:
        p.pencolor("#3df5ff" if z < 0 else "#173a52")
        p.width(2 if z < 0 else 1)
        p.goto(x, y)
        p.pendown()
    s.update()


for i in range(1, 12):
    lat = -m.pi / 2 + m.pi * i / 12
    path([project(lat, 2 * m.pi * j / 90) for j in range(91)])
for i in range(18):
    lon = m.pi * i / 18
    path([project(-m.pi + 2 * m.pi * j / 90, lon) for j in range(91)])

t.done()

s = t.Screen()

p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()

pinks = ["#ffb7c5", "#ff9eb5", "#ffc8dd", "#ffe5ec", "#ff85a2"]


def blossom():
    for _ in range(3):
        p.dot(random.randint(6, 11), random.choice(pinks))
        p.penup()
        p.forward(random.uniform(3, 7))
        p.left(random.uniform(90, 150))


def branch(length, width):

        blossom()
        return
    p.width(width)
    p.pencolor("#3b2418" if width > 3 else "#5c3a2a")
    p.pendown()
    p.forward(length)
    sub = random.randint(2, 3)
    spread = random.uniform(40, 70)
    for k in range(sub):
        turn = -spread / 2 + spread * k / (sub - 1) + random.uniform(-8, 8)
        p.left(turn)
        branch(length * random.uniform(0.6, 0.75), width * 0.7)
        p.right(turn)
    p.penup()

# Hiperbolik Ağ
import turtle as t
import math as m
import colorsys

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#000000")
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()
p.width(1)

N = 90
twist = 30


def top(i):
    a = 2 * m.pi * i / N
    return 230 * m.cos(a), 230 + 55 * m.sin(a)


def bottom(i):
    a = 2 * m.pi * i / N
    return 230 * m.cos(a), -230 + 55 * m.sin(a)


for i in range(N):
    p.pencolor(colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(0.45 + 0.4 * i / N, 0.7, 1))
    p.penup()
    p.goto(top(i))
    p.pendown()
    p.goto(bottom(i + twist))
    p.penup()
    p.goto(top(i))
    p.pendown()
    p.goto(bottom(i - twist))
    s.update()

p.pencolor("white")
p.width(2)
for ring in (top, bottom):
    p.penup()
    for i in range(N + 1):
        p.goto(ring(i))
        p.pendown()
s.update()
t.done()

    p.goto(-260, y0 - 4)
    p.end_fill()

    p.goto(pts[0])
    p.pendown()
    for pt in pts:
        p.goto(pt)

# Pisagor Ağacı
import turtle as t

s = t.Screen()
s.setup(700, 700)
s.bgcolor("#050a05")
s.colormode(255)
s.tracer(0)
p = t.Turtle()
p.hideturtle()

DEPTH = 10


def square(pts, depth):
    f = depth / DEPTH
    col = (int(120 * f + 40 * (1 - f)), int(70 * f + 220 * (1 - f)), int(30 * f + 90 * (1 - f)))
    p.color("#000000", col)
    p.penup()
    p.goto(pts[0])
    p.pendown()
    p.begin_fill()
    for pt in pts[1:] + pts[:1]:
        p.goto(pt)
    p.end_fill()


def tree(x1, y1, x2, y2, depth):
    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    x3, y3 = x2 - dy, y2 + dx
    x4, y4 = x1 - dy, y1 + dx
    x5 = x4 + 0.5 * (dx - dy)
    y5 = y4 + 0.5 * (dx + dy)
    square([(x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3), (x4, y4)], depth)
    if depth > 4:
        s.update()
    if depth > 0:
        tree(x4, y4, x5, y5, depth - 1)
        tree(x5, y5, x3, y3, depth - 1)


tree(-55, -280, 55, -280, DEPTH)
s.update()
t.done()
